note: Copilot & AI #7. BILLED: Fabric capacity F2 (about 0.395 EUR per hour while running, owner decision). The F2 must exist at least 24 hours before recording (Copilot can take 24 h to recognise it): run this prepare once the day before (the create statement is idempotent), then pause it; every take resumes it and teardown pauses and deletes the resource group. Only trial-no-copilot runs on the Fabric trial capacity. Manual setup the script cannot do: workspaces Contoso Copilot Lab (on the F2) and Contoso Trial Lab (on the trial), lakehouse lh_contoso with the five CSVs, notebook nb_copilot_demo, charts for verified answers, Power BI Pro or trial for labadmin. A screen that needs a second capture of another kind lists it under 'then'.
prepare: # owner signs in (browser or device code) as labadmin
if (-not $env:MG_LABADMIN_UPN) { $env:MG_LABADMIN_UPN = Read-Host 'labadmin sign-in name (owner types, never shown)' }
az group create --name rg-mglab-copilot-07 --location westeurope --tags purpose=mglab-copilot-ep07 -o none

if (-not (az fabric capacity show --resource-group rg-mglab-copilot-07 --capacity-name mglabcopilotf2 --query name -o tsv 2>$null)) { az fabric capacity create --resource-group rg-mglab-copilot-07 --capacity-name mglabcopilotf2 --location westeurope --sku '{name:F2,tier:Fabric}' --administration "{members:[$env:MG_LABADMIN_UPN]}" --tags purpose=mglab-copilot-ep07 -o none }
az fabric capacity resume --resource-group rg-mglab-copilot-07 --capacity-name mglabcopilotf2 2>$null
Push-Location src; python -m copilot_pbi lint C:\MGLab\work\copilot-07\before\ContosoSales.SemanticModel; Pop-Location

Push-Location src; if (-not (Test-Path C:\MGLab\work\copilot-07\after)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\MGLab\work\copilot-07\after | Out-Null; python -m copilot_pbi describe C:\MGLab\work\copilot-07\before\ContosoSales.SemanticModel data\descriptions-contoso-bikes.json --out C:\MGLab\work\copilot-07\after\ContosoSales.SemanticModel; Copy-Item C:\MGLab\work\copilot-07\before\ContosoSales.pbip, C:\MGLab\work\copilot-07\before\ContosoSales.Report C:\MGLab\work\copilot-07\after\ -Recurse }; Pop-Location

Push-Location src; python -m copilot_pbi lint C:\MGLab\work\copilot-07\after\ContosoSales.SemanticModel --instructions data\ai-instructions-contoso-bikes.md --verified data\verified-answers-plan.json --fail-on info; Pop-Location
# manual (owner): Fabric admin portal, Tenant settings, Copilot and Azure OpenAI Service: confirm Users can use Copilot and other features powered by Azure OpenAI is on (change nothing)
# manual (owner): the star-schema CSV files of Power BI episode 1 must be in C:\MGLab\power-bi\star\ (DataFolder parameter, keep the trailing backslash)

# manual (owner): open both projects once in Power BI Desktop, add a clustered bar chart Sales Amount by Category and a line chart Margin % by Year Month to the page, save; check Orders Shipped shows 149 for June 2025 by Date[Year Month]

screens.name: trial-no-copilot
steps: Open the workspace Contoso Trial Lab (on the Fabric trial capacity), then Workspace settings, License info and show the trial capacity
Open a report in the workspace
Show the real Copilot state: button missing, or the message that none of the workspaces has the necessary capacity
If Copilot DOES work on the trial stop: the script, the needs slide and the README must be rewritten
mask: tenant name in the top bar and address bar

screens.name: copilot-before
steps: Open C:\MGLab\work\copilot-07\before\ContosoSales.pbip (DataFolder parameter set), Settings gear: Copilot workspace = Contoso Copilot Lab (F2 resumed)
Open the Copilot pane, skill picker Answer questions about the data
Ask: Show sales by country for 2025 (country is ambiguous: customer vs store)
Ask: How many orders were shipped in June 2025? (validated: 149 shipped, 145 ordered)
Open How Copilot arrived at this for both answers; keep whatever Copilot answers, right or wrong
mask: tenant name and account e-mail in the Desktop title area and sign-in card

screens.name: prep-data-ai
steps: Open C:\MGLab\work\copilot-07\after\ContosoSales.pbip, Home ribbon, Prep data for AI (turn on Q&A first if the tabs are disabled)
Tab Add AI instructions: paste the text of src\data\ai-instructions-contoso-bikes.md
Tab Simplify data schema, then one verified answer on the bar chart with three trigger phrases from src\data\verified-answers-plan.json
Apply; then open the Properties pane of [Sales Amount] and show its description

screens.name: copilot-after
steps: Close and reopen the Copilot pane after Apply (required for the changes to take effect)
Ask again: Show sales by country for 2025 and How many orders were shipped in June 2025?
Ask: Which product category made the most margin in 2025? (validated: Bikes 312,551.80)
Show the answers next to the validated results; if one is still wrong keep it (outputs are nondeterministic)

screens.name: fabric-notebook
steps: Open workspace Contoso Copilot Lab (F2), lakehouse lh_contoso with the five CSV files loaded as tables
Open notebook nb_copilot_demo attached to it and open the Copilot chat pane
Use the starter prompt: Profile my table to check columns, missing values, and duplicates
Show Copilot asking permission to add a code cell, approve, show the result
Then pause the capacity (teardown does it too)
mask: tenant name in the address bar and top bar

teardown: az fabric capacity suspend --resource-group rg-mglab-copilot-07 --capacity-name mglabcopilotf2 2>$null

# manual (owner): delete the workspaces Contoso Copilot Lab and Contoso Trial Lab (with lakehouse, notebook, semantic model); in Desktop clear the Copilot workspace choice; check Cost Management shows nothing else billed
needs: paid:fabric-f2 (about 0.395 EUR/hour, pause after every take, delete the resource group)
blocked: copilot-before, prep-data-ai, copilot-after and fabric-notebook need the paid F2 capacity (owner decision, created at least 24 hours earlier); only trial-no-copilot can be recorded without it.
